facts.fact: Flora 求妈妈出钱做评估被拒——信讬基金 25 岁才解锁
facts.anchor: You can’t have money from your trust fund until you’re twenty-five.

facts.fact: 妈妈全盘否认她的自我怀疑，把 ADHD/autism 说成「淘气男孩家长的借口」
facts.anchor: You don’t have ADHD or autism. That’s an excuse that parents of naughty boys use.

facts.fact: 妈妈把校园霸凌重新定义为「教你合群」，并断言「你有问题」
facts.anchor: They weren’t bullying you. They were teaching you to fit in.

facts.fact: 妈妈拿 Clive 早提基金失败当反例，让她用烹饪学校那份「小破工作」自己攒钱
facts.anchor: you’ll have to save money from your silly little cookery school job

facts.fact: Garett 来电约遛狗，Flora 借不到钱也不敢开口，谎称只想问狗零食
facts.anchor: I was going to ask if you’d like some more treats for Cookie

facts.fact: 为躲开 Clouds 一家（尤其 porn incident 之后），她盘算谎称住朋友家、睡在学校夹层
facts.anchor: I could tell Jem I’m staying at a friend’s and sleep here.

facts.fact: 顶替名额的少年 Bailey 要求她整晚说脏话助兴，两人达成交易
facts.anchor: Will you swear all evening? I don’t want to be here, and it might make it fun.

facts.fact: Flora 认出 Max 长得像她前一天看的片里的 boss（灰白发+络腮胡）
facts.anchor: he resembles the boss in the porn I was watching before the Cloud family barrelled in

facts.fact: Bailey 摊牌：七岁时偷听到 Max 和妈妈的谈话，4 月赛季一完就飞回美国打 NHL
facts.anchor: You’re only living here until April and then flying home as soon as the last game of the season is done
